content.short: Squid is a cross-chain liquidity and messaging router that enables one-click swaps across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Squid Router is a premier cross-chain swap and liquidity routing protocol built on the Axelar Network, designed to eliminate the friction of multi-chain asset management. The platform enables users to execute 'one-click' swaps between any token on any supported network—such as swapping native ETH on Ethereum for native SOL on Solana—in a single transaction. By utilizing Axelar's General Message Passing (GMP), Squid can execute complex logic across different blockchain architectures while maintaining high throughput and security. Squid features 'Squid Boost' for transactions in seconds.
content.meta: Squid Router offers high-speed cross-chain liquidity routing and one-click token swaps. Discover Squid and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
